items.description: Translation from Spanish to English, 2 hrs
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): translation of police reports and supporting documents for the claim is not indemnifiable, even if necessary for substantiation.
Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): working materials and ancillary charges for translation are not indemnifiable.

items.description: Compensation for stolen watch (premium replacement model, upgrade on the one taken)
items.rationale: Indemnified as a valuable (4.2.2) taken by force (2.3.1), but capped at the EUR 2,500 per-item valuables sub-limit (4.2.2, 6.3, 7.1.1). Upgrade over pre-loss standard is not indemnified (7.1.9); only the cost of an equivalent standard-grade replacement is covered, subject to the sub-limit and deductible (7.8).

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: Indemnified as means of payment (4.2.3) taken by force (2.3.1), but capped at the EUR 500 means-of-payment sub-limit (4.2.3, 6.3, 7.1.1).

items.description: Replacement of designer sunglasses (mislaid separately, not taken in robbery)
items.rationale: Not indemnified: item was not taken in the insured event (2.3.4(a), 7.1.5, 7.1.10); mislaid property is excluded.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): shipping, carriage, delivery and comparable charges are not indemnified, even if related to replacement property.
